answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and derives a private rate-limit secret committed into a Semaphore zero-knowledge tree. It evaluates an epoch polynomial whose identity commitment binds each authorized message. A duplicate message exposes two shares of the secret; Shamir reconstruction reveals the private key, while RLN verifies the proof and triggers immediate collateral slashing. The sonnet, orchard, and harbor labels serve only as domain-separated context.
